issues.INVALID_NODE_ID: Node id '{{id}}' must be lowercase kebab-case.
issues.DUPLICATE_NODE_ID: Node id '{{id}}' is used more than once.
issues.INVALID_ASSIGNEE: Task must assign at least one actor, role, or discipline.
issues.EDGE_UNKNOWN_NODE: Transition references a node that does not exist.
issues.EDGE_DUPLICATE: Duplicate transition between the same nodes.
issues.NON_DECISION_CONDITION: Conditions are only allowed on decision branches.
issues.CONDITION_INCOMPLETE: Transition condition is missing a field or a value.
issues.CONDITION_UNKNOWN_REF: Condition references '{{ref}}', which is not a declared input.
issues.INVALID_INPUT_CODE: Input code must use lowercase letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, or underscores.
issues.ENTRY_REQUIRED: A workflow must include exactly one start node.
issues.ENTRY_UNIQUE: The workflow has more than one start node.
issues.ENTRY_INCOMING_EDGE: The start node must not have incoming edges.
issues.ENTRY_SINGLE_OUTPUT: The start node must have exactly one outgoing edge.
issues.EXIT_REQUIRED: A workflow must include at least one end node.
issues.EXIT_OUTGOING_EDGE: An end node must not have outgoing edges.
issues.TASK_SINGLE_OUTPUT: Each task must have exactly one outgoing edge.
issues.DECISION_OUTPUTS: Each decision must have at least two outgoing edges.
issues.DECISION_DEFAULT_EDGE: A decision may have at most one default branch.
issues.UNREACHABLE_NODE: Node '{{id}}' is not reachable from the start.
issues.CYCLE_DETECTED: The workflow graph must not contain cycles.
issues.FORM_VERSION_REQUIRED: Tasks referencing a form need a pinned version to publish.

panel.title: Graph issues
panel.locateHint: Click an issue to select its node.

publish.confirmBody: Publishing makes this version drive patient pipelines. Consultations already in progress keep following the version they started with. To change it later, publish a new version.
publish.withdrawBody: The version is unlocked and editable again. It will not be published.
publish.publishedBody: Version {{version}} is now driving patient pipelines.
publish.saveFailed: Fix the validation issues before publishing.
publish.errorGeneric: Could not publish the workflow. Try again.
publish.errorNoDraft: The workflow draft is no longer available. Reload the page and try again.

preview.title: Workflow preview
preview.disclaimer: Preview mode uses simulated test data. Nothing here is saved.

status.completed: Simulation completed — the workflow reached an end node.

blockReason.noExit: a step has no outgoing transition
blockReason.noBranchTaken: no decision branch matched the test data
blockReason.cycle: the workflow loops and never reaches an end

preview.noInputsHint: Declare data inputs in the workflow settings so transitions can be simulated.
preview.traceHint: Press Run to trace the path this workflow takes with the test data above.
preview.noRulesHint: Add a decision node with conditions to inspect its transition rules here.
preview.validationNotice: The graph has validation issues, so the simulation may not reflect the published behavior.
